## What does this change do?

Describe the problem, proposed solution, and affected components.

## Verification

- [ ] I used only synthetic or publishable test data.
- [ ] I tested the change, or explained why tests could not run.
- [ ] I added or updated documentation when behavior changed.
- [ ] I checked that the change preserves fail-closed behavior and owner/governed admission boundaries.
- [ ] I checked single-writer and provenance implications.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, private memory, machine access details, or production configuration.
- [ ] I disclosed any third-party code and licensing requirements.

## Evidence

List commands and results (when relevant), test fixture hashes, or reproducible verification steps.

## Open questions and risks

Describe limitations, incompatible behavior, or any design decision requiring maintainer approval.
